This document outlines the inspection 
checklist for Communication System. The system is depending on a PLC control 
unit. The maximum capacity of the system is (96 line/36 Trunk) and the used 
capacity is (88 line/8 Trunk).

items:
A Work 
 Order must be issued; the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety Category.

Safety 
 Fence with caution marks surrounding the work Area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, Shoes, anti static hand probe to avoid electrical choke and 
 electrostatic effects.
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning.

Power Check:
 * Use the multi-meter to check the 220v AC power source
 * Open the front cover of the panel and Check the 4 Red 
 LEDS 
 * Notice the power leds that indicates the power good 
 states.
 * There 
 are 4 RED LEDS for power states
 * 220v AC (Input Voltage)
 * 24v DC (Output Voltage)
 * 12v DC (Output Voltage)
 * 5v DC (Output Voltage)

Switch off the power source by turning off 
 the main power switch.

Use the Vacuum Cleaner to clean the 
 following parts:Panel rack, Electronic cards, Battery bay.

Switch on the power source by turning on 
 the main power switch and wait for the program to complete its loading 
 process.

Recheck the power LEDS For 220 VAC input - 
 and (24,12,5)VDC Outputs

Introduction
The First 
Draft Initiated by Eng. Islam Sabry on 5/3/2005, Submitted by
Eng. 
Ibrahim Hefny on 7/3/2005, Reviewed by EDEP CO. Quality Control Eng. Abdel Menem 
Al Emam and, Accepted by General Director Eng.Hamdy Azab and Approved by Eng. 
Fawzy Sobhy Ismael Head Sector of Abu Sultan Power Plant.
This document outlines the inspection 
checklist for Communication System. The system is depending on a PLC control 
unit. The maximum capacity of the system is (96 line/36 Trunk) and the used 
capacity is (88 line/8 Trunk).
Safety Precautions
A Work 
 Order must be issued; the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety Category.
Safety 
 Fence with caution marks surrounding the work Area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, Shoes, anti static hand probe to avoid electrical choke and 
 electrostatic effects.
Tools and Equipment
Digital Multi-meter.
Screw Driver Kit.
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning.
Work to be Carried Out
Visual inspection for PLC system
Power Check:
 * Use the multi-meter to check the 220v AC power source
 * Open the front cover of the panel and Check the 4 Red 
 LEDS 
 * Notice the power leds that indicates the power good 
 states.
 * There 
 are 4 RED LEDS for power states
 * 220v AC (Input Voltage)
 * 24v DC (Output Voltage)
 * 12v DC (Output Voltage)
 * 5v DC (Output Voltage)
Switch off the power source by turning off 
 the main power switch.
Use the Vacuum Cleaner to clean the 
 following parts:Panel rack, Electronic cards, Battery bay.
Retighten the wirings and cards.
Switch on the power source by turning on 
 the main power switch and wait for the program to complete its loading 
 process.
Recheck the power LEDS For 220 VAC input - 
 and (24,12,5)VDC Outputs
